vision.name: Black Perceptive Mastery
vision.text:
[Continuous]: Your Styled attacks gain "HIT: Destroy an opponent's Setup or Drill."
POWER: Destroy the top card of your Life Deck to destroy the top card of your opponent's Life Deck. If your opponent destroyed a Physical Combat or Energy Combat card, your MP gains 4 stages. Otherwise, raise a player's anger 1.
vision.note: portrait FanZ Mastery layout (title bar mid-card, MASTERY label below text); title and number confirmed from a crop of the original
